comment: Adjudicated findings baseline (U2', user-approved 2026-10-22). Only findings finally adjudicated as design-intent or false-positive may be entered; real defects must never be listed. Key = path + anchor + content hash of the anchor's +-3 line window (any code change at the anchored location invalidates the entry). Maintained on main only; max 10 entries; TTL <= 90 days; every entry cites its adjudication chain. Suppressed findings stay visible in the review summary tagged [adjudicated-suppressed].

entries.finding_message_pattern: qa-ok bare always() / fork PR qa-ok red (skipped != success)
entries.adjudication_ref: round-3 #5 adjudication: qa-ok bare always() + four execution legs success-only is fail-closed design, NOT a defect (relaxing skipped acceptance = zero-execution required-check fake green, #358/#372 isomorphism; a context gate on a required check = missing check instance = ruleset passes = fake green). Contract locked by test_qa_ok_fork_semantics_pinned. Re-raised round-6 shard-5 (qa.yml:323) and round-7; round-7 rejection verified in evidence/m2-round7-p1x3-verification.md #1: on a private repo fork count = 0, zero real victims, purely theoretical surface; a fork PR's red qa-ok is the CORRECT consequence of fork PRs never being mergeable (forks lack update-branch eligibility; the fork exit is not merge). The workflow line number drifts across PRs (323/325) but the anchor line content is stable.
